{{Top|leg}}
'''Hinder Island''' was a plateau on [[Recopia]]. It was where animal traders held the [[Hinder Market]]. Hinder Island, like other plateaus on the planet was only reachable by air transport. A small [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] was built there.<ref name="CCW">''[[Coruscant and the Core Worlds]]''</ref>
